title: Compare – VOOL load management vs ordinary load balancing
description: What changes when a charging system measures the building in real time and moves cars between phases.

sections.title: Not all load management is the same
sections.lead: Most systems limit charging so the fuse holds. VOOL also moves each car to the least loaded phase, so the capacity you already pay for is used.
